race.comment: SO POLITE (7) sets the standard after resuming with a third at Gawler in BM64 grade, beaten only a long neck by Summertime Madness, and her record at this track and distance reads four placings from four attempts. She also brings a strong association with Teagan Voorham and looks well placed to turn consistent form into a win. CHILLI REAPER (4) is in excellent order, having won at Mt Gambier then charging home for second at Murray Bridge despite interference and difficulty getting clear. Can threaten. SAMANTH (6) returned with a sharp second at Port Lincoln in BM68 company at big odds and Lauren Stojakovic has won two from three aboard her, though her unplaced record at this venue keeps her just behind the leading pair. Include in wider plays. FLIRT (9) has been freshened since a plain Halidon sixth, but her prior Class 2 placing and 1050m record keep her in the mix.
